$comment: Machine codes. Never translate. Plain sentences translate; chips and codes do not. Packet B first-hour deliverable alongside strings.en.json.
rule: codes[] are the only permitted machine labels on chips, event rows, money states, account flags, and ledger events. Do not localise, reword, or expand acronyms.

codes.meaning: Citizen report captured; no institution has yet written back about the money.
An institution has placed a provisional hold on a named amount.
A hold landed for less than the amount that arrived at that institution.
A freeze/hold has been asked of an institution; not yet a hold. Render as asked (dashed), never as held.
Money left this institution for a further hop. One branch on Asha's Day-2 spine.
Location of this amount is not known to the ledger.
Amount restored to the complainant, typically via interim custody.
A previously standing hold was lifted. Does not merge with any remaining hold.
Returned amount is held in interim custody pending complainant confirmation before close.
Amount that left before a hold landed. Asha: ₹500, permanently unrecoverable, never rounded away.
Full complaint accepted; acknowledgement number issued.
Anonymous report accepted. Confirmation only; not trackable.
1930 helpline log entry.
Citizen e-consent to FIR. Proposed online step; not in today's SOP.
Terminal close is gated on complainant confirmation of returned funds.
Digital banking switch ON. Orthogonal to amount-hold and seizure.
Seizure switch OFF/NONE. Court order only; do not infer from a hold.
Mock SMS OTP dispatched. The code shown in the on-screen toast is the only valid code.
Entered digits matched the toast code.
Track-status result for an unknown acknowledgement number.
Anonymous-report boundary. Record exists for confirmation; it cannot be tracked.
Citizen-filed complaint. Ack number issued; status can be tracked with registered-mobile OTP.
Reconstruction of bank-side reality. Ages until confirmed. Never enters a sworn statement or a DEADLINE claim. Badge text is [ASSUMPTION].
Our design; exists nowhere in today's SOP. Badge text is [PROPOSED].
Documented fact. Badge text is CONFIRMED.
Clock badge. Counts from the theft. Never translate the badge word; the explainer beside it is a translatable pair.
Clock badge. Counts from this slip's own timestamp. Never translate the badge word.
Clock badge. Appears only with a written rule. Never translate the badge word.
Clock badge. Always labelled ours. Never translate the badge word.
